items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: a lot of good players down in Florida, Flip Phillips and Bill and John Allred

ctx.x: Well yeah, well I grew up in the New York/New Jersey area, and I worked Eddie Condon’s for quite a while, and I’ve always been kind of in and out of the New York scene even though I live in Florida. I just don’t like living in New York. It’s not one of my favorite places. And it’s not the same place I grew up in. There’s not as much going on in New York as when I was a kid in the 60s and 70s. I mean there was a lot more going on then than there is now. There’s not very much of a club scene there anymore. I mean…

scene in Florida, a lot of good players down in Florida, Flip Phillips and Bill and John Allred, a lot of great players, Johnny Varro, a lot of guys around there, so there’s a lot more going on there.
Did you ever have occasion to associate with Sol Yaged by any chance?
